message.content:
**Triangulation Metrics** is a function that evaluates the quality and characteristics of triangulation runs performed on a set of products and branches over a specified time window (defaulting to the last 90 days). It aggregates and summarizes key performance indicators (KPIs) related to the triangulation process, such as:

| Metric | What it measures | Typical use |
|--------|------------------|-------------|
| **Total Runs** | Number of triangulation jobs executed | Gauge overall activity |
| **Success Rate** | % of runs that completed without errors | Assess reliability |
| **Average Runtime** | Mean duration of successful runs | Identify bottlenecks |
| **Peak Load** | Highest concurrent runs observed | Capacity planning |
| **Data Volume** | Total amount of data processed | Storage & bandwidth estimation |
| **Error Types** | Distribution of error categories | Root‑cause analysis |
| **Branch Coverage** | % of branches that had at least one run | Coverage completeness |
| **Product Coverage** | % of products that had at least one run | Coverage completeness |

The function typically pulls raw run logs from the backend, aggregates them per product/branch, and returns a JSON payload containing the above metrics. This allows stakeholders to monitor the health of the triangulation pipeline, spot trends, and make data‑driven decisions about scaling or debugging.
